name: Context Pacer
description: Paces agents that gather with tools: a status line on each gathering result, with nudges to write notes and to finish from them, and optionally large results moved to files. Never blocks a tool.

agents.description: Agent ids to pace. Empty (the default) paces no agent.

gatherTools.description: Tools whose results count as gathering and get the status line.

notes.description: Note tracking. Off unless pathContains is set.

pathContains.description: A write counts as a note when its path contains this text. No default: unset turns note tracking off.

tools.description: Tools that can write a note.

everyResults.description: Ask for a note once this many gathering results pass without one.

wrapUpContextFraction.description: Share of the context budget at which the line says to stop gathering and write the answer.

maxTrackedRuns.description: Most runs tracked in memory at once; the oldest is dropped beyond this.

offload.description: Save large gathering results to the workspace the agent's tools run in and show an excerpt with the file's path instead.

enabled.description: Turn offload on. Applies to unsandboxed agents and to Docker or Podman sandboxes.

thresholdChars.description: Offload a result once the text the model would see exceeds this many characters.

excerptChars.description: Characters of the saved result shown in its place; at most thresholdChars minus 1,000.

directory.description: Workspace-relative folder for saved results, with one subfolder per run. It is inside the workspace the agent's tools run in, so a sandboxed agent can read it.

maxRuns.description: Run folders kept in the directory; older ones the pacer created are deleted.

maxBytesPerRun.description: Most bytes saved per run (per attempt with the conversation-access grant); past this, results stay in context unchanged.
